blockingFindings.title: Coverage artifact points to the wrong test path
blockingFindings.target: Requirement-to-Test Coverage Artifact: requirements[].files and files[].file
blockingFindings.rationale: A requirement coverage artifact that contradicts the actual test files is an explicit blocking condition for this review.
blockingFindings.issue: The artifact claims every requirement is covered by `tests/acceptance-test-migration.test.js`, but the provided spec-local test file is `specs/332-acceptance-test-migration/tests/acceptance-test-migration.test.js`. That contradicts the actual test file location.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Change the coverage artifact file references to the actual spec-local test path, or provide the referenced `tests/acceptance-test-migration.test.js` if that is the intended executable coverage file.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A requirement coverage artifact that contradicts the actual test files is an explicit blocking condition for this review.

blockingFindings.title: R9 does not prove disabled tests are absent
blockingFindings.rationale: R9 requires the complete target regression files to pass without weakened assertions; skipped or todo tests are a static test-design anti-pattern that can pass without exercising required production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R9 is named as checking target files pass without disabled tests, but `assertHistoricalFilePasses` only checks exit status and a minimum pass count. A target regression file could skip or todo tests while still exiting 0 and meeting the minimum pass count.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend the R9 executable checks to fail when any target regression reports skipped or todo tests, or otherwise statically detects disabled tests in those files.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R9 requires the complete target regression files to pass without weakened assertions; skipped or todo tests are a static test-design anti-pattern that can pass without exercising required production behavior.
